title: Letter to Church Leaders in Geneseo, New York, 23 November 1833
source_note: JS on behalf of the Kirtland high priests, Letter, Kirtland Township, Geauga Co., OH, to “Dearly beloved brethren,” Geneseo, Livingston Co., NY, 23 Nov. 1833. Retained copy, [between ca. 23 and 27 Nov. 1833]; handwriting of Oliver Cowdery; three pages; CHL. Bifolium measuring 12⅜ × 8 inches (31 × 20 cm). The text of the letter is on the recto and verso of the first leaf and on the recto of the second leaf. The letter was originally cataloged with Minute Book 1, though its provenance is unknown.
